src_dc27e87bee50.title: सदस्य:धतरवाल जाट
src_dc27e87bee50.author: Wikipedia user (धतरवाल जाट)
src_dc27e87bee50.summary: यह हिंदी विकिपीडिया की एक सदस्य-पृष्ठ (draft) है जो धतरवाल गोत्र के इतिहास का वर्णन करती है। इसके अनुसार नाथु धतरवाल (नाथुजी) ने बारह गांव बसाए, जिनमें नाथुवास (नाथौर) सबसे प्रमुख था और नाथुजी के नाम पर बसाया गया। इनमें से 9 गांव महाजन फील्ड फायरिंग रेंज के लिए 1981-1986 के बीच खाली करवाए गए; विस्थापितों को संसारदेसर, करणीसर, कृष्णनगर, तख्तपुरा, सामरथा, वारानी तथा नाथुसर वास सहित नहर-सिंचित क्षेत्रों में बसाया गया। पाठ jatland.com के धतरवाल पृष्ठ से मिलता-जुलता प्रतीत होता है।
evidence_snippets: सबसे प्रमुख नाथुवास था जो नाथुजी के नाम पर बसाया गया
शेष 9 गांव सन् 1981 से 1986 के मध्य खाली करवा दिए गए
संसारदेसर, करणीसर, कृष्णनगर, तख्तपुरा, सामरथा, वारानी तथा नाथुसर वास
src_dc27e87bee50.attribution: Hindi Wikipedia userspace draft, सदस्य:धतरवाल जाट

claims.statement_hi: नाथौर (नाथुवास) की स्थापना धतरवाल गोत्र के नाथु धतरवाल ने की थी।
claims.statement_en: Nathor (Nathuwas) was founded by Nathu Dhatarwal of the Dhatarwal clan.
claims.snippet: सबसे प्रमुख नाथुवास था जो नाथुजी के नाम पर बसाया गया

claims.statement_hi: गांव का नाम नाथुजी धतरवाल के नाम पर पड़ा।
claims.statement_en: The village is named after Nathu Ji Dhatarwal.
claims.snippet: नाथुवास ... जो नाथुजी के नाम पर बसाया गया

claims.value: Khinyana, Sulera, Bhikhnera, Kumbhana, Kolana, Ajeetwana, Ladera, Bhanabasti, Meghana, Manera, Thoiya, Nathor
claims.statement_hi: नाथु धतरवाल द्वारा बसाए गए बारह गांवों में नाथौर (नाथुवास) एक था।
claims.statement_en: Nathor (Nathuwas) was one of twelve villages founded by Nathu Dhatarwal.

claims.statement_hi: नौ गांव 1981 से 1986 के बीच महाजन फील्ड फायरिंग रेंज हेतु खाली करवाए गए, जिनमें नाथौर भी था।
claims.statement_en: Nine of the twelve villages, including Nathor, were vacated between 1981 and 1986 for the Mahajan Field Firing Range.
claims.snippet: शेष 9 गांव सन् 1981 से 1986 के मध्य खाली करवा दिए गए

claims.value: Sansardesar, Karnisar, Krishnanagar, Takhatpura, Samartha, Varani, Nathusar Vas (canal-irrigated areas)
claims.statement_hi: विस्थापितों को संसारदेसर, करणीसर, कृष्णनगर, तख्तपुरा, सामरथा, वारानी तथा नाथुसर वास सहित नहर क्षेत्रों में बसाया गया।
claims.statement_en: Displaced families were resettled in Sansardesar, Karnisar, Krishnanagar, Takhatpura, Samartha, Varani and Nathusar Vas, among other canal-irrigated areas.
claims.snippet: संसारदेसर, करणीसर, कृष्णनगर, तख्तपुरा, सामरथा, वारानी तथा नाथुसर वास

claims.statement_hi: सुलेरा, भिखनेरा और मेघाणा तीन गांव फायरिंग रेंज से बाहर रह गए और खाली नहीं करवाए गए।
claims.statement_en: Three of the twelve villages -- Sulera, Bhikhnera and Meghana -- remained outside the firing range and were not vacated.
claims.snippet: तीन गांव (सुलेरा, भिखनेरा, मेघाणा) रेंज से बाहर रह गए

reasons: strong geo context: ['Mahajan', 'महाजन', 'Mahajan Field Firing Range']

src_7da0e757971f.title: Dhatarwal - धतरवाल (Jatland Wiki)
src_7da0e757971f.summary: Jatland's Dhatarwal clan page surfaced in search results and in Google's AI-overview summary as the origin of the claim that Nathor/Nathuwas was one of twelve Dhatarwal-founded villages named after Nathu Dhatarwal, with a temple to नाथूदादा (Nathu Dada) at Khinyana inside the Mahajan Field Firing Range. Could not be fetched directly -- the site returned HTTP 403 to every WebFetch attempt (direct URL, Google Translate proxy, Bing cache). Content very likely matches the hi.wikipedia userspace draft recorded separately.
evidence_snippets: नाथौर (नाथुवास) was primarily known as a settlement named after नाथुजी, and all these villages belonged to the धतरवाल community
There is a shrine dedicated to नाथूदादा in the महाजन फील्ड फायरिंग रेंज near the village खीयाणा

claims.statement_hi: महाजन फील्ड फायरिंग रेंज के भीतर खीयाणा गांव के निकट नाथूदादा का एक भव्य मंदिर धतरवाल समुदाय द्वारा बनवाया गया है।
claims.statement_en: A grand temple to Nathu Dada was built by the Dhatarwal community near Khinyana village inside the Mahajan Field Firing Range.
claims.snippet: There is a shrine dedicated to नाथूदादा in the महाजन फील्ड फायरिंग रेंज near the village खीयाणा ... with a grand temple constructed by the धतरवाल community

src_7da0e757971f.notes: URL retained per rules even though the page itself could not be fetched (403 Forbidden on direct fetch, translate.goog proxy, and cache attempts) -- a human researcher with browser access should try this page directly, it appears to be the primary/original source for the Dhatarwal-Nathor founding narrative.

src_253a66da3f7f.summary: MapsOfIndia listing page administratively confirms Nathor as a village under Lunkaransar tehsil, Bikaner district, Rajasthan, with a Google Map locator. No population, pincode, or historical detail is given on the page -- consistent with the village's post-acquisition status (no current inhabited-village data to show).

claims.statement_en: Nathor village is administratively located in Lunkaransar tehsil, Bikaner district.

src_c0a313e97116.title: Villages in Lunkaransar Tehsil, Bikaner

src_c0a313e97116.summary: Full directory of ~120-139 current villages in Lunkaransar tehsil. Nathor does NOT appear in this active-village listing, while a separate 'Nathusar' does appear -- indirect corroboration that Nathor was administratively absorbed/depopulated (consistent with 'acquired' status) rather than still functioning as a normal revenue village today.
evidence_snippets: Nathor does not appear among them
'Nathusar' appears in the list with a dedicated link

claims.statement_hi: वर्तमान लूणकरणसर तहसील की सक्रिय गांव-सूची में नाथौर का नाम नहीं है, जो इसके अधिग्रहण/निर्जन होने के अनुरूप है।
claims.statement_en: Nathor does not appear in the current active village list for Lunkaransar tehsil, consistent with it having been acquired/depopulated.
claims.snippet: Nathor does not appear among them

src_c0a313e97116.notes: CAUTION: this list separately shows a 'Nathusar' village still active under Lunkaransar tehsil -- distinct from Nathoosar/Nathusar in Nokha tehsil (a negative_term decoy) AND possibly distinct from or a renamed remnant of Nathor/Nathuwas itself. Could not verify which; flagging for human review, do not auto-merge with Nathor.

src_cf1e6f8e9b09.title: Nathoosar Village Population - Nokha - Bikaner, Rajasthan
src_cf1e6f8e9b09.summary: 2011 Census mirror for 'Nathoosar' village, which is in Nokha tehsil (not Lunkaransar/Mahajan) of Bikaner district, ~40 km from Nokha and ~70 km from Bikaner city -- a different village from Nathor/Nathuwas despite the similar name. Population 5,279 (2,793 M / 2,486 F), 766 households, 55.53% literacy. Recorded explicitly as a name-collision decoy, not as evidence about Nathor.
